curriculum: The 180 EC programme has ten 7.5 EC compulsory courses, a 60 EC major choice section and 45 EC profiling. Advanced methods (7.5) and thesis (15) are required in the choice section, leaving 37.5 EC of other major choices. In the two structured pathways, the other choices are Development, Learning and Behaviour, Parenting and Society, Pedagogical Practice Development, Communication Skills, and one 7.5 EC advanced choice: Testing and Observation Skills for CCFES or Doing a Qualitative Research Project for YES. The 2026–27 teaching schedule confirms the year sequence. The free pathway leaves the other 37.5 EC open within the approved list and level rules. The erratum adds introductory law for social scientists as an intermediate choice. The programme is mainly Dutch, with several courses taught in English.
progression: The OER requires 37.5 EC at each of intermediate and advanced levels in the major, with additional advanced credits permitted to replace intermediate credits. Six compulsory intermediate courses already cover 45 EC. The two advanced shared requirements, advanced communication and the either-or elective account for 37.5 advanced EC. The 45 EC profiling choices must supply at least 7.5 advanced EC to reach 45 EC advanced overall and at least 15 EC at intermediate level or higher. The thesis requires passing all three sequential research-methods courses and the optional pedagogical internship requires passing four of eight designated courses. The first-year pedagogical practicum is embedded in the teaching sequence, with the recommended development course linked to it.
